rd-db28e8c69.text: `InferenceIncidKKCondLogitIVWC.Rd` (unclear): The page calls the IVWC formula "the classical fixed-effects inverse-variance meta-analysis pooling formula (see Cochrane Handbook / DerSimonian-Laird)". DerSimonian-Laird is the random-effects method, which adds a between-study variance term. The pooling shown here (w* = s_r^2/(s_r^2+s_m^2), combined variance s_m^2 s_r^2/(s_m^2+s_r^2)) is the fixed-effects one, so the citation points readers to the wrong method (inference_incidence_KK_cond_logit.R:990).
